message:
Command `cat > /workspace/candidate_trace.json << 'EOF'
[
  {"step": 1, "file": "oss-fuzz-example/fuzz_complex_parser.c", "function": "LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput", "line": 24, "var": "data", "code": "char *ns = malloc(size+1); memcpy(ns, data, size); ns[size] = '\\0';", "note": "Attacker-controlled input bytes are copied into a heap buffer of size+1 bytes, null-terminated."},
  {"step": 2, "file": "oss-fuzz-example/fuzz_complex_parser.c", "function": "LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput", "line": 27, "var": "ns", "code": "parse_complex_format(ns);", "note": "The heap buffer pointer is passed to the vulnerable parser."},
  {"step": 3, "file": "oss-fuzz-example/char_lib.c", "function": "parse_complex_format", "line": 91, "var": "length", "code": "size_t length = strlen(input);", "note": "length is 40 for the crafted input, satisfying the length >= 8 guard."},
  {"step": 4, "file": "oss-fuzz-example/char_lib.c", "function": "parse_complex_format", "line": 93, "var": "input[0..3]", "code": "if (input[0] != 'F') ... if (input[3] != 'z')", "note": "Input starts with 'Fuzz', passing the format prefix checks."},
  {"step": 5, "file": "oss-fuzz-example/char_lib.c", "function": "parse_complex_format", "line": 105, "var": "sum", "code": "for (int i = 0; i < length; i++) { if (input[i] > 0x20) { sum += 1; } }", "note": "sum counts chars > 0x20. With 'Fuzz' (4) plus 15 'A' chars, sum = 19, which is < 20."},
  {"step": 6, "file": "oss-fuzz-example/char_lib.c", "function": "parse_complex_format", "line": 108, "var": "length", "code": "return read_key_figures(input, length);", "note": "Because sum < 20, read_key_figures is called with half_length = length = 40."},
  {"step": 7, "file": "oss-fuzz-example/char_lib.c", "function": "read_key_figures", "line": 70, "var": "half_length", "code": "if (half_length < 10) { return -1; }", "note": "half_length = 40 >= 10, so the guard passes."},
  {"step": 8, "file": "oss-fuzz-example/char_lib.c", "function": "read_key_figures", "line": 74, "var": "half_length", "code": "half_length += half_length;", "note": "half_length is doubled to 80, which exceeds the 41-byte heap buffer size."},
  {"step": 9, "file": "oss-fuzz-example/char_lib.c", "function": "read_key_figures", "line": 75, "var": "half_length", "code": "return get_the_right_character(input, half_length);", "note": "The out-of-bounds index 80 is passed to get_the_right_character."},
  {"step": 10, "file": "oss-fuzz-example/char_lib.c", "function": "get_the_right_character", "line": 61, "var": "input", "code": "if (strlen(input) < 40) { return -1; }", "note": "strlen(input) = 40, so the guard passes and execution proceeds to the OOB read."},
  {"step": 11, "file": "oss-fuzz-example/char_lib.c", "function": "get_the_right_character", "line": 63, "var": "c", "code": "char c = input[idx];", "note": "Reads input[80], which is beyond the 41-byte heap allocation, causing a heap-buffer-overflow READ."}
]
EOF
echo "Trace created" && python3 -c "import json; json.load(open('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')); print('Valid JSON')"` executed with exit code 0.
